items.title: Record diesel prices drive UK inflation to 1-year high of 3.6%
items.summary: U.K. inflation rose to 3.6% in the 12 months to October, its highest level in a year, as fuel costs continued to rise.

items.title: Japan exports in October surge 20.5%, beating estimates on robust chip shipments
items.summary: Japan's exports in October surged 20.5% from a year earlier, snapping a two-month slowdown in shipments, official data released Wednesday showed.

items.title: St. Louis Fed's Musalem says four more rate hikes may be needed in coming months
items.summary: St. Louis Federal Reserve President Alberto Musalem indicated Tuesday that the central bank may need as many as four rate hikes in coming months, offering one of the most hawkish views yet by a Fed policymaker about the steps needed to quell inflation.
